text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: runtime-prod - sustained queue growth on inference-workers-3 across us-west-2. 50-90s tail latency, 5xx up from 0.2% -> 3.8%. Trigger: runtime.queue_length > 500 for 3m. Paging oncall
Maya Patel: reading dashboard, reproducing in logs now. looks like sustained backlog on the long-seq pathway (context > 8k).
Raj Singh: seeing a lot of requests hitting model-quantized-v2 and then stalling on KV cache writes. GC spikes on host 10.12.44.8.
Zoe Chen: customer-facing impact? any 429/504 reports?
Maya Patel: alerting shows increased 504s to a handful of customers. AcmeCorp saw 504s for ~300 requests in last 10m. No full outage.
Alex K: quick mitigation options: (1) reduce max_inflight on runtime to throttle new in-flight requests, (2) enable aggressive shedding for long-context, (3) temporarily disable long-context-mode feature flag, (4) tighten per-customer rate limits for heavy tenants.
Maya Patel: agree. doing (1)+(3) first. planning step: set runtime.max_inflight=40 from 80, flip ff.long_context=false on prod, and reduce request timeout to 10s from 30s. rollback plan in 15m if errors spike.
Ben Thornton: want me to apply config or you? I can run quick CLI.
Maya Patel: please apply. I'll monitor.
Ben Thornton: running now:
```
# apply throttle and timeout
rctl apply --env=prod --path=runtime --set max_inflight=40
rctl apply --env=prod --path=runtime --set request_timeout_ms=10000
flags set --env=prod long_context_mode=false
```
Ben Thornton: done. changes propagated to us-west-2 clusters.
SRE Pager: confirm config propagation across shards?
Ben Thornton: propagation shows success on 8/8 shards, legacy-shard-2 pending (about a minute).
Maya Patel: turning on shedding for long sequences at 75th percentile: runtime.shedding.long_seq_pct=75.
Raj Singh: also lowered per-customer burst for top 10 noisy tenants. ran:
```
rctl update-quota --customer=acme-corp --burst=100 --rate=10
rctl update-quota --customer=beta-inc --burst=50 --rate=5
```
Zoe Chen: noting customer communications: outreach to AcmeCorp support already opened (ticket #INC-4321). CS notified.
Maya Patel: metrics after 3m: queue length dropped ~60%, tail latency down to 15-25s, 5xx rate trending down to 0.8%. AcmeCorp 504s reduced to ~5 in last 5m.
Alex K: nice. next: decide on disabling similarity-ranking fallback (nonessential) for 10m to reduce internal CPU. Maya?
Maya Patel: hold on that unless we see relapse. keep as next step.
SRE Pager: risk assessment: current mitigations are throttling new inflight which increases headroom but may cause more client-facing 429s for heavy users. We already tightened quota for heavy tenants to avoid uncontrolled backlog.
Ben Thornton: monitoring alarms set:
```
- rate: 5xx > 1% for 5m -> paging
- queue_len > 300 -> ticket
- avg_latency > 20s -> pager
```
Maya Patel: handing off at 1768004500 to Ben for the rest of the oncall window. Notes in runbook: if queue stabilizes for 20m, gradually restore max_inflight to 60 then 80 over 30m windows. If 5xx rises above 2% after restore, reapply 40 and open postmortem.
Ben Thornton: ack handoff. I'll keep watching and coordinate CS updates.
Zoe Chen: adding customer impact summary: AcmeCorp ~300 504s peak, reduced to ~5 after mitigation. Beta-inc saw increased 429s (~120) after quota tighten; CS notified. No SLA breaches yet, but close.
Raj Singh: follow-up action for infra: investigate KV cache write latencies on host 10.12.44.8 and check disk io pattern. Might need kernel tweak or restart of runtime worker.
Maya Patel: file a follow-up ops ticket and assign to infra team (ticket INF-987).
SRE Pager: we should keep this as P2. timeline: initial mitigation at 1768004360, handoff at 1768004500. moving to monitoring mode. please update thread with any customer escalations.
Ben Thornton: monitoring shows stable for 10m, queue at ~120. I'll start gradual restore in 15m per runbook. restore steps logged.
Maya Patel: thanks team. if anything flares, ping oncall. I'll draft short post-incident summary after 1h. :white_check_mark:
